name: Waveshare 10.3" IT8951 on Pico Plus 2 W (Bedside)
description: Waveshare 10.3 inch e-Paper HAT (IT8951 controller, ED103TC2 glass, 1872x1404, 16-level greyscale) driven by a Pimoroni Pico Plus 2 W over the Hard Stuff Pico-to-Pi-HAT adapter, running tesserae-device-bedside. Mains powered (PowerBoost load-sharing), always on: advertises can_stay_awake and polls /frame on awake_poll_s. Same glass and controller as the Seeed reTerminal E1003, so the frame is the esp32_gray_bin 4-bpp buffer (1314144 bytes).
notes_md: Wire format is exactly 1314144 bytes (1872*1404/2), row-major, top-left origin, no mirror; high nibble = LEFT pixel, 0x0 black .. 0xF white. The firmware un-mirrors the ED103TC2 glass itself. Buttons: the device reports `left`, `right` and `refresh` (knob and keys arrive in a later firmware phase, with their names set in Controls). Firmware: https://github.com/dmellok/tesserae-device-bedside
